# Hashed local folder creation stores the real name separately in summary metadata

This landing keeps the safe filesystem name in SetMailboxName and writes the raw folder name through nsDBFolderInfo::SetFolderName when the two names differ. That receiver stores the folderName character property. The inspected ReadDBFolderInfo branch can use a nonempty property for a nonlocalized folder name after it opens folder info. The new mbox/maildir test checks summary contents for a seeded folder with a hashed leaf. It does not exercise cache deletion, a fresh folder object or an actual restart; setter and native storage failures were not executed.

Scope: Local store folder-name persistence.
